speaker: Mr Darryl David
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry has data on how many persons with disabilities (PwDs) have applied for jobs through the Employment and Employability Institute in the last five years; (b) how many of these PwDs successfully found employment that lasted more than six months; and (c) whether the Government has a strategy for the public and private sectors to enhance employment opportunities for PwDs.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Under the ODP, SG Enable works with several job placement and job support partners, such as Autism Resource Centre, Movement for the Intellectually Disabled of Singapore and SPD.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: These partners provide coaches who are trained to assist PwDs with their job search and provide post-placement on-site support to help these jobseekers adjust into their new roles.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The job coaches also advise employers on adapting job tasks and the work environment to better suit the needs of employees with disabilities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: To enhance employment opportunities for PwDs, we aim to increase their employability and grow the network and the number of inclusive employers through a whole-of-society effort.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Employers and community partners, such as disability social service agencies, play a key role in supporting the employment of PwDs.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: This includes training, sharing best practices and implementing inclusive hiring at the workplace.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: The Government will work with partners to equip PwDs with skills that enable them to take on employment opportunities.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: We encourage employers to approach SG Enable and to tap on the ODP and other employment support services to hire, train and integrate PwDs into their organisations.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: It is very encouraging to know all the work that is being done and I hope will continue to be done for PwDs.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: If I could ask a supplementary question, Sir.

speaker: Mr Darryl David (Ang Mo Kio)
text: Is the Government prepared to consider setting up a more permanent or more dedicated department or structure which relies on Singapore's successful tripartite model of working with unions, employers and the Government, to specifically cater to the employment and job needs of PwDs.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: The tripartite partners, indeed, will be very willing to work together to support the employment and upskilling of PwDs.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: This is a new structure and institution – a one-stop shop for employers, social support agencies, PwDs, tripartite partners and the whole-of-society to come together to support PwDs in finding jobs and also to help them keep employed.
